procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
USA 5399 (Bow 45) was represented by Travis Odenbach.
Race Committee was represented by Daniel Gibbons (Pin end boat).
Daniel Gibbons (Pin end boat) provided video evidence.
facts: In race 2 black flag was displayed as the preparatory signal.
Just before the start, the race committee identified USA 5399's (Bow 45) hull in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark.
USA 5399 was scored BFD in race 2.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
